messages.Text: getting ABDM-1056 when i link care context, what does it mean

atoms.body:
# ABDM-1056, already linked, or an invalid link reference

## In plain words

The code carries two messages, and the message tells you which case you are in:

- "This care contexts has been already linked": the [care context](/docs/hiecm/v3/getting-started/glossary#care-context) is already linked to this patient.
- "Invalid Link Reference Number": the link reference number you sent matches nothing issued in this link flow.

In user initiated linking, the link init exchange can carry it in an `error` object. The message there is "This care context has already been linked".

## Before you start

Keep your own record of the care contexts you have linked and the reference numbers you used. This code usually means your state and the gateway's state disagree.

## When it goes wrong

Already linked: treat it as done once you have confirmed the care context is linked, and do not retry the link. Invalid reference number: restart the link flow for a fresh reference rather than guessing the value.

reply.Text:
**ABDM-1056** has two possible meanings — the error message will tell you which:

1. **"This care context has been already linked"** — the care context is already linked to this patient. Treat it as done and don't retry.

2. **"Invalid Link Reference Number"** — the link reference number you sent doesn't match any reference issued in this link flow. Restart the link flow to get a fresh reference instead of guessing.

**Fix**: Keep your own record of the care contexts you've linked and their reference numbers. Usually this error means your state and the gateway's state disagree. If you're getting the "already linked" message, verify the care context is actually linked and skip the retry. If you're getting "invalid reference", start a new link flow from the beginning.

Which message are you seeing in the error response?
